Ken Alibek is a former Soviet bioweapons scientist who defected to the United States in 1992. He is known for his significant contributions to the field of biological science, particularly in the area of bioweapons research and development. Alibek was the head of the bioweapons program at the Soviet Academy of Medical Sciences and the chief of the Soviet bioweapons program from 1985 to 1992.
